description: The bar chart illustrates the number of datasets categorized as "Untargeted" and "Targeted" over a period from 2013 to 2021. The horizontal axis represents the years, while the vertical axis indicates the number of datasets, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160. Each year is represented by a pair of bars, with the "Untargeted" datasets shown in blue and the "Targeted" datasets in orange. The bars are not sorted in any specific order. The chart does not include any visual emphasis such as shading or bolding on the bars.
